title: getAllowedTransitions returns full action set for 'active' certification status (no longer stranded)
description: Regression guard: an earlier build had CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS missing an 'active' key so the WorkflowActionPanel rendered zero buttons for active certs. WorkflowTransitionService.getAllowedTransitions('certification','active') in trust-vault-service/src/core/workflow/WorkflowTransitionService.ts must return ['expiring_soon','revoked','archived','needs_revision'], and this must stay in sync with the frontend CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS.active array in WorkflowActionPanel.jsx.
preconditions: WorkflowTransitionService instantiated with a test Db handle
steps: Call service.getAllowedTransitions('certification', 'active')
Assert the returned array equals ['expiring_soon', 'revoked', 'archived', 'needs_revision'] (order-independent set comparison)
Cross-check against CERT_STATUS_ACTIONS.active in vibrantix-client-panel/src/components/trust-vault/workflow/WorkflowActionPanel.jsx
expectedResult: Backend and frontend allowed-transition sets for 'active' match exactly; the array is non-empty.

title: getAllowedTransitions rejects an out-of-map target for 'draft' status
steps: Call service.transition('certification', draftCertId, 'active', userId) directly from 'draft' status
Inspect the thrown error
expectedResult: transition() throws with statusCode 422, message 'Invalid transition: draft → active for certification', and err.allowedTransitions === ['assigned'].

title: RevisionModal close-action note validation requires 30 trimmed characters, not 30 raw characters
description: MIN_CLOSE_NOTE_LENGTH = 30 in RevisionModal.jsx is compared against note.trim().length (trimmedNote), so leading/trailing whitespace cannot be used to pad a short justification to the minimum.
steps: Type a 29-character string padded with 5 leading/trailing spaces (34 raw chars) into the justification Textarea
Read meetsMinLength / isSubmitDisabled
Type a 30-character non-whitespace string
Read meetsMinLength / isSubmitDisabled again
expectedResult: With the padded 29-char string, meetsMinLength is false and the submit button stays disabled (counter shows 29/30). With the 30-char string, meetsMinLength is true and submit becomes enabled.

title: computeCertScore awards points additively for active count, framework diversity, and sharing
description: VaultHealthService.computeCertScore (trust-vault-service/src/services/VaultHealthService.ts) starts at 0 and adds 40 (>=1 active), +20 (>=3 active), +20 (>=2 distinct frameworks), +20 (any shared), capped at 100.
steps: Call computeCertScore({ total:0, active:0, expiringSoon:0, expired:0, shared:0, distinct_frameworks:0 })
Call computeCertScore({ total:1, active:1, expiringSoon:0, expired:0, shared:0, distinct_frameworks:1 })
Call computeCertScore({ total:5, active:3, expiringSoon:0, expired:0, shared:1, distinct_frameworks:2 })
expectedResult: Scores returned are 0, 40, and 100 respectively (40+20+20+20 capped). 'details' text reflects '0 active certifications' vs the active count and framework count in the other two cases.

title: toGrade maps overall score to letter grade at exact boundary values
steps: Call toGrade(90), toGrade(89), toGrade(80), toGrade(79), toGrade(70), toGrade(69), toGrade(60), toGrade(59)
expectedResult: Returns A, B, B, C, C, D, D, F respectively — boundaries are inclusive on the lower edge of each grade band (90=A, 80=B, 70=C, 60=D, <60=F).

title: Expiry alert level classification is correct at exact day-count thresholds
description: ExpiryAlertService default thresholds are urgent<=7, warning<=30, info<=60 (getExpiringForOrganization). Verifies a cert expiring in exactly 7, 8, 30, 31, 60, and 61 days is bucketed correctly with no off-by-one error.
steps: Construct certifications with expiryDate exactly 7, 8, 30, 31, 60, and 61 days from now
Call getExpiringForOrganization(orgId) and read alertLevel per cert
expectedResult: Day 7 → urgent, day 8 → warning, day 30 → warning, day 31 → info, day 60 → info, day 61 → excluded from the info bucket (beyond the default 60-day threshold).

title: anonymizeIp zeroes the last IPv4 octet and passes through non-IPv4 values unchanged
description: ShareLinkService.anonymizeIp (trust-vault-service/src/services/ShareLinkService.ts) implements a GDPR-style IP anonymisation used by getAccessHistory. Only 4-part dot-separated strings are rewritten; anything else (IPv6, null, malformed) passes through as-is.
steps: Call anonymizeIp('203.0.113.42')
Call anonymizeIp('2001:db8::1')
Call anonymizeIp(null)
expectedResult: '203.0.113.42' → '203.0.113.0'; the IPv6 string is returned unmodified; null returns null.

title: getPasswordStrength scores a share-link password based on required vs optional character-class rules
description: ShareLinkModal.jsx's getPasswordStrength() treats length>=6 and 1+ digit as the two REQUIRED rules and uppercase/special-char/12+-length as optional boosters. A password meeting only the two required rules is scored 'fair' (60), not 'strong', even though PASSWORD_COMPLEXITY_REGEX (used for submit-gating) is satisfied.
steps: Call getPasswordStrength('pass1') (5 chars, has digit — fails length rule)
Call getPasswordStrength('passw1') (6 chars + digit only — meets both required rules, no optional)
Call getPasswordStrength('Passw1!23456') (12+ chars, digit, uppercase, special — all rules met)
expectedResult: 'pass1' → { strength: 'weak', score: 33 } (only 1 of 2 required met); 'passw1' → { strength: 'fair', score: 60 }; 'Passw1!23456' → { strength: 'strong', score: 100 }.
